Cowper printed the hymn under Hebrews 12:8. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons. HEBREWS 12:8 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ HEBREWS 12

Did I meet no trials here, No chastisement by the way; Might I not, with reason, fear I should prove a cast–away: Bastards may escape the rod, Sunk in earthly, vain delight; But the true–born child of GOD, Must not, would not, if he might. STANZA III
